description: This file is a PHP source file that implements a database driver class for Oracle OCI8 within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It contains class definitions, methods for database connection, query execution, transaction management, and handling of Oracle-specific features such as BLOBs/CLOBs and sequence management.

classes.name: ADODB_oci8
classes.description: Main class implementing Oracle OCI8 database driver methods, including connection management, SQL execution, transaction control, and BLOB/CLOB handling.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oci8
classes.description: Recordset class for handling Oracle query results with methods for fetching, navigating, and retrieving field information.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ext_oci8
classes.description: Extended recordset class for OCI8 with additional movement and fetch capabilities.

methods.name: ADODB_oci8
methods.description: Constructor for the ADODB_oci8 class, initializes internal variables and checks for OCI8 fetch support.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table, including name, type, length, nullability, and default values.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Returns the current server time as a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Oracle database using various connection modes.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the connected Oracle server, including version and compatibility.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Persistent connection wrapper.

methods.name: _nconnect
methods.description: Non-persistent connection wrapper.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns an NVL SQL expression for handling null values.

methods.name: DBDate
methods.description: Formats a date for insertion into Oracle in TO_DATE format.

methods.name: BindDate
methods.description: Binds a date value for SQL execution.

methods.name: BindTimeStamp
methods.description: Binds a timestamp value for SQL execution.

methods.name: DBTimeStamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp for insertion into Oracle.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks specific rows in a table for update.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about available tables and views.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about table indexes.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits a transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back a transaction.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects a database, not applicable for Oracle, returns false.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Constructs an Oracle TO_CHAR SQL expression for date formatting.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Performs a query with limit and offset, optimized for Oracle using rownum.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates BLOB or CLOB fields with provided data.

methods.name: UpdateBlobFile
methods.description: Stores file data into BLOB or CLOB fields.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes SQL statements, with support for prepared statements and parameters.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds PHP variables to statement parameters, including LOBs.

methods.name: Param
methods.description: Returns a parameter placeholder string for binding.

methods.name: Parameter
methods.description: Binds a variable to a named parameter in a prepared statement.
